data.additional_information:
Smartex Climate initiative
Background Information + Importance: Steel is a highly emission-intensive hard-to-abate sector, and its engineering property versatility and ubiquity has meant that it is difficult to find a substitute for steel. Smartex Steel Energy Transition is a decarbonization initiative that aims to tackle this issue by de-risking capital and technology with an enabling ecosystem of end consumers, EPCs, OEMs and multiple stakeholders involved to enable steel industry decarbonization.
At present, there is no such ecosystem to collaboratively tackle sustainability leading to wasted effort, time, and money, with multiplicity of same efforts. We need to find an economically sustainable way to build and develop this ecosystem and find market compatible ways in which all stakeholders can engage helping the industry fully decarbonize.
Current state: Steel industry and most other hard-to-abate industries operate in a very price sensitive competitive commodity market. There is hardly any distinction between pre-competitive technologies and competitive steel finishing technologies. This leads to a difficult environment for ecosystem collaboration. We need a definitive synergy and an orchestrated action across the supply chain as a whole in order to decarbonize the industry.  Steel companies have managed the vertical supply chain and pre-competitive technology internally, bringing in outsiders as needed. This has created a culture and mindset to consider pre-competitive technology as a competitive advantage, a fallacy that is now hindering decarbonization efforts to take shape across the industry and supply chain due to lack of coordination and no overall system thinking. We need velocity and efficiency on time, money and effort across the industry to make the timeline for the 1.5 degC target.
Your WILL
Please consider carefully before applying. We seek individuals who care deeply about the climate challenges facing humanity and aspire to build the capacity to tackle these issues. We are looking for change-makers who understand their role and responsibility in calling this planet home and are committed to doing whatever it takes to preserve it for the future generations.
In our organization, there is no hierarchy; we facilitate each other's progress and succeed together. We prioritize knowledge and data over opinions and speculation. Therefore, individuals seeking to climb hierarchies may be better suited to organizations designed for such pursuits.
This position is not suitable for those seeking a merely comfortable or settled approach to life. We highly recommend it for individuals who are prepared to grapple with the exponential challenges posed by climate change, involving business, technology, and humanity. Join us to regenerate and redesign our way of living, working, and playing on this planet as we navigate global transition to sustainable energy. We invite the future entrepreneurs to join us and learn how to become compassionate and conscientious entrepreneurs, utilizing our holistic framework encompassing business, technology, and humanity.
If you are a topical expert and a leader who can influence across multiple functions, disciplines, clients and within own teams then we are interested to speak with you.
General Skills
•    These positions are going to work with very senior level steel industry professionals.
•    Require consultative approach and ownership of work product and solution delivery.
•    Have strong verbal, visual and written communication skills to assist in translating data insights for understanding. 
•    Strong critical reasoning/analytical thinking, problem solving, project management, attention to detail and cross-functional collaboration/influencing skills.
•    Experience presenting to senior stakeholders.
•    Ability to set objectives and drive to results while building long-term relationships across organizational boundaries.
•    Multi-organization collaboration experience required
•    Prepare independently study reports and presentations
•    MS office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) skills are essential.
•    Relevant software skills as per the job requirement are essential.
•    Hard-to-abate sector experience is must, preferably steel 
•    Consulting and client solution background is preferable
•    Demonstrated expertise in critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and fact-based analysis.
•    Background experience could include petrochemical, steam power, and other high temperature process plant engineering.  
•    Software programming skill is a plus
Skills:
•    Technoeconomic and life cycle studies experience
•    Experience with thermal-mass balancing analysis, feasibility and detailed project report 
•    Process knowledge of Gas based Direct Reduction of Iron, EAF and/or Blast Furnace/BoF Steel technology experience is a plus.
•    Understanding of iron and steel end-end process.
•    Operations experience in plants would be ideal, any discipline.  
•    Process engineering background/understanding with grasp of possibilities and pitfalls with new solutions, and be able to assess client’s situation and needs.
•    Exposure to natural gas and/or hydrogen is a plus
________________________________________
Key Competencies:
•    Detail-oriented with the ability to work on complex projects.
•    Adaptability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
•    Strong commitment to innovation and continuous improvement.
o    Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
o    Excellent written and verbal communication skills for creating impactful reports and presentations.
•    A proactive approach to thought leadership and industry engagement.
________________________________________
Application Process:
Interested candidates are requested to submit their:
1.    Updated resume highlighting relevant experience.
2.    Portfolio of reports, feasibility studies, or publications (if applicable).
Position: SET Enabler 
•    PhD or Pursuing PhD
•    3+ years’ work experience in the related field. Exceptional candidates with standout topical expertise may apply with less experience.
•    A prior consulting experience is a plus. 
Work Locations and Travel
•    Durgapur (West Bengal)
•    Nagpur or Chandrapur (Maharashtra)
•    Periodic travel required.
